messages:
lena: Quick triage — PRD candidate for combined chat/completions + embeddings + rerank launch. Need a concise scope-cut list and acceptance criteria we can show sales for enterprise asks (deterministic rerank, on-prem parity). Two tradeoff axes: cost/latency vs quality/regression risk. Initial asks below, pls react.

matt: +1 on a MUST/HAVE/NICE breakdown. Must: API parity for rerank + embedding shape compatibility, SLA targets for dedicated customers. Have: streaming chat support for low-latency paths. Nice: full embedding-update webhooks at GA.

devon: FYI customer "AcmeCorp" wants on-prem rerank with 99th pct latency <300ms for 512-token chat requests. They also want deterministic ranking across replicas. Is that feasible in scope? :thinking_face:

priya: We should require fallback variants and telemetry before GA. Suggest acceptance criteria snippet: 
```
AC-1: Rerank endpoint returns stable score ordering across identical inputs and pinned seeds for 95% of tests.
AC-2: Hosted/Dedicated must meet latency SLOs: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 220ms for 512 tokens (batching on).
AC-3: Embedding API returns stable vectors with <3% drift post-quantization compared to float baseline.
AC-4: Automatic fallback: if primary model exceeds error rate threshold, route to cheaper quantized model and emit telemetry + incident.
AC-5: Rollout plan + canary for Dedicated with A/B toggle and automatic rollback on metric regression.
```
These are fairly strict but protect customers and product.

kevin: My pragmatic cut: postpone embedding-update webhooks (nice) and full deterministic-replay infra (nice). Focus GA on: rerank parity for hosted/dedicated, streaming chat basic, fallback quantized variant + monitoring. That reduces infra work by ~2 sprints.

lena: Agree with kevin. We also need to call out edge cases in PRD: mixed-model routing (user prompt token length > model max), zero-shot rerank failures, and embeddings for very short inputs (<=3 tokens) where cosine similarity noise spikes.

matt: Operational acceptance: include runbook snippet, rollback criteria, and cost guardrails. Example guardrail: if per-token cost > 1.5x baseline for >15 mins, trigger automatic throttling and notify eng-oncall.

priya: Also add evals: regression suite with 10k prompt pairs for rerank (customer-provided golden sets + internal buckets). Perf harness should simulate dedicated pool contention.

deploy-bot: deploy window scheduled: 1945685000 - 1945690000 UTC for canary rollout. Reminder: update release notes and support KB.

devon: Quick Q: for deterministic rerank, do we require pinned RNG seeds in router or do we document non-determinism for dedicated until we implement replay?

lena: For GA, doc non-determinism but include deterministic-mode flag behind enterprise toggle. We’ll ship deterministic-mode disabled by default; enable for customers with contract and perf caveats.

matt: Next steps: priya to update PRD ACs and add test plan. kevin to produce scope-cut delta & rough effort estimate. lena to consolidate and post to /eng for implementation sign-off. Please ack when you’ve taken tasks. :thumbsup:
